leads.summary: sanitizeValue() drops every measure_* / meter_* number above 30000 as a Tuya error value. It wraps setCapabilityValue for every device built on BaseUnifiedDevice, so real values above that ceiling are discarded silently: outdoor illuminance above 30000 lux (direct sunlight), a cumulative meter_power above 30000 kWh, measure_power above 30 kW on a whole-house meter. The capability would stay frozen on its last accepted value.
leads.status: open, found by code reading, no user report yet
leads.fix_plan: Replace the blanket ceiling with per-capability bounds (keep the 0xFFFF / 65535-style sentinels as errors only where the capability cannot reach them, e.g. temperature, humidity, battery). Regression test first: measure_luminance 45000 and meter_power 31000 must pass through; 65535 on measure_temperature must still be dropped. Master is under the P3095 publish hold, so master goes after the hold clears; stable-v5 and bastien-home can take the same simple fix (Bastien rule: same time as master).
